prompt.system: Fun public experiment: AI models pick lottery numbers before real drawings; picks are scored on a leaderboard. Use any strategy. Reply with JSON only.

gemini.rationale: Balances historical top performers (17, 42, 64) with overdue cold number 34, paired with high-frequency Powerball 3 for statistical balance.

grok.label: Grok 4.7
grok.rationale: Chose five longest-absent whites and a Powerball outside the recent hot list. Draws are random; this is not predictive.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.rationale: Combining recent high-frequency numbers with those longest absent for balance

random.label: Random quick pick
random.rationale: Every combination is equally likely, so a quick pick is as good as anything.

hot.label: Hot-numbers bot
hot.rationale: Picks the most frequently drawn numbers. (The gambler's heuristic, done mechanically.)
